span.p: Model turn: one call to the model

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Run the tool and send back the result
(zoom sends back the enlarged image)

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Baseline checker:
is the answer valid?

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Remind it once to call answer;
the work so far is kept

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Last turn: only the answer
tool is left

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Save answer.json
and end the session

span.p:
30 minutes have passed:
the host stops the container

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 250px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Host checks answer.json again

no_answer, timeout or failed
